<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Advanced Element Control](/Feats.aspx?ID=4336) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 57

**Archetype** [Kineticist](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=206)

**Prerequisites**
[Through the Gate](/Feats.aspx?ID=4335)

</column>

---

You gain one [kineticist feat](/Feats.aspx?Traits=504). For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your kineticist level is equal to half your level. Your options include [impulse](/Traits.aspx?ID=502) feats for your kinetic element, as normal for a kineticist.

**Special** You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another kineticist feat.

<title level="2">Advanced Element Control leads to...</title>
[Add Element](/Feats.aspx?ID=4338)
name: Advanced Element Control
